blind.B1: No for an exercise question. The RNA-seq is soleus of Stard7 flox/flox control vs Myf5-Cre muscle-KO (mKO), n=3 per group (S2.5.p1, FLT.p3 Fig 3A). Exercise (treadmill S2.3, lactate S2.4) is phenotyping on other cohorts; no sequenced sample carries an exercise factor and metadata have no exercise words.
blind.B2: mKO vs control soleus, 3 vs 3 (S3.3.p1; FLT.p3 'n = 3 per group'). Only comparison in the transcriptome.
blind.B3: No repeated measures. FLT.p3: 'Each dot represents an individual animal (n = 3 per group)'; one tissue (soleus), one time. The packet's candidate keys (title minus genotype, i.e. rep1-3) only encode replicate number; the expression check is not_supported (same-key r 0.136 vs other -0.068, permutation p 0.18). Not a pairing unit.
blind.B4: Paper says edgeR with filterByExpr on all samples (FLT.p3); only one contrast, so joint vs pairwise is moot.
blind.B5: FLT.p3: 'Genes with |log fold change| > 1 and FDR < 0.05 were defined as DEGs' (edgeR, filterByExpr; GO/WikiPathways adjusted p < 0.05). No DEG total given in text; named down genes Mybpc2, Actn3, Pvalb, Mct4, Myh4; Myh7 unchanged.

checks.evidence: S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1, FLT.p3: only genotype contrast; no exercise arm in RNA-seq samples. Refusal at design matches B1.
WT 3 / mKO 3 matches paper n=3 per group; no exclusions; alignment 6/6 exact on geo_accession.

Mechanical flag pairing_key_candidate is spurious: key = replicate index; FLT.p3 says each dot is an individual animal; pairing_check status not_supported (p=0.18). Record 'repeated_measure_unit: none (independent animals)' is correct.
Single two-group contrast, no model fitted.
Single sex-unspecified, single tissue; no batch info in metadata; not reached since stopped.
Per-sample files hold only a TPM column summing to 1e6 although data_processing says raw counts; recorded as discrepancy. Paper's edgeR route not possible from deposit.
FDR<0.05, |logFC|>1 (strict >) transcribed correctly from FLT.p3 in paper_reconstruction and HANDBACK.
No DE run; HANDBACK claims no counts and notes paper gives no total.

'No exercise contrast' is true: the search covered metadata (single genotype column, no exercise words) and the paper (exercise only on separate cohorts, S2.3/S2.4, FLT.p2). Claim is not a narrow-search absence.

human_items: Open policy: a genotype-only series (muscle KO with exercise-intolerance phenotype) is refused for an exercise question; if the person wants it as a genotype baseline reproduction, that would be a declared deviation (limma on log2 TPM).
summary: 该系列只有 soleus 中 WT 对 mKO 的基因型比较(3 对 3),RNA-seq 样本没有运动组,在 design 阶段拒绝是正确的。自动标记的 pairing_key_candidate 只是重复编号 rep1-3,论文说每个点代表独立动物,表达检查也不支持配对,属于误报。阈值、矩阵类型(TPM 与 GEO 说明不符)等记录均准确。
